policy_source: /workspace/x64-run/LANES.md §1 (table takes precedence over contradictory §4 WINHTTP stub list)

classification_semantics.system: Resolve to the real OS DLL or API-set contract; planned routing does not certify export availability.
classification_semantics.uwph: Resolve through the uwph/Wine loader: host-backed builtins or unchanged game-supplied modules as specified by reason.
classification_semantics.stub: Resolve imports via Wine builtin/stub backends; successful loading and runtime tolerance remain separate work.
classification_semantics.wine-pe: Pinned Wine PE mapped with strict native imports; initialized and behavior-tested through launcher Play; does not certify every export or a device backend.

advapi32.dll.reason: Native advapi32 from System32 for crypto/token/user-name imports (resolves in the AppContainer). The console refuses Reg* writes under HKCU (RegCreateKeyW/RegCreateKeyExW -> ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, runs/reg/evidence), so the nine Reg* imports of UnityPlayer.dll are overridden to the uwph registry builtin backed by LocalState\registry.sqlite (legacy registry.json import).

overrides.reason: uwph registry builtin (reg_builtin.h) backed by LocalState\registry.sqlite (legacy registry.json import); same signatures and Win32 error codes; console refuses HKCU key creation/writes.

d3d10.dll.reason: The console has d3d11.dll and dxgi.dll but no d3d9.dll, d3d10.dll, d3d10_1.dll or d3d10core.dll, so a guest importing one of them fails to load. Play ships its own shim (src/xbox-test/uwph/d3d10, built by mingw and mapped by Play's loader) in the runtime directory; its d3d11.dll!D3D11CreateDevice import reaches Play's device hook and its swapchains go through the validated CoreWindow adapter. A guest copy in the game folder is mapped first and wins.

dbghelp.dll.reason: GameAssembly directly imports SymInitialize/SymFromAddr despite LANES §1 crash-handler-only claim; planned clean-failure symbolization stubs need validation.

dinput8.dll.reason: Built from pinned Wine 10 source like the other donors. DirectInput 8 for games that import it statically: keyboard and mouse through the u32c record core, joysticks through the hid/setupapi donors (controllers reach games through XInput). Mapped only after its focused behavior gate (create + enumerate); a failure withholds dinput8 alone.

ucrtbase.dll.reason: Native Universal CRT (OS component on the console): api-ms-win-crt-* contracts resolve to it, and the vcruntime140 route forwards to its exception-handling, RTTI and string exports.

userenv.dll.reason: Native user profile API (GetUserProfileDirectoryW) for home-directory lookups.

vcruntime140.dll.reason: VC++ redistributable absent on the console (LoadLibrary 126). Unless the game ships its own copy, uwph/vcruntime forwards the names to ucrtbase.dll (as Wine 10 does) and implements the few vcruntime-only helpers.

vcruntime140_1.dll.reason: x64 FH4 handler (__CxxFrameHandler4), absent on the console; uwph/vcruntime forwards it to ucrtbase.dll as Wine 10 does.

winmm.dll.reason: Historical stub policy is retained for the frozen Wine research oracle. The launcher audio provider resolves the 23 real Unity WINMM imports from System32 with per-export console diagnostics; export availability and output playback are verified separately. No successful-return shim replaces a missing native export.

ws2_32.dll.reason: Native Winsock passthrough per LANES §1; console TCP works, while AF_UNIX remains unavailable.
